description:
Prince Adam returns to claim his destiny in Masters of the Universe, the new live-action fantasy action film based on the iconic Mattel franchise. The movie stars Nicholas Galitzine as He-Man, with Jared Leto, Idris Elba, Morena Baccarin, Alison Brie, Camila Mendes, and Jóhannes Haukur Jóhannesson in the cast. It is directed by Travis Knight and is set for a theatrical release on June 5, 2026 through Amazon MGM Studios.

Director: Travis Knight.

Wile E. Coyote is done getting blown up by ACME junk. In Coyote vs. Acme, he finally takes the company to court after years of disastrous gadgets failing in his endless chase of the Road Runner. The live-action/animated film stars John Cena, Will Forte, and Lana Condor, is directed by Dave Green, and is currently set for theatrical release on August 28, 2026.

Director: Dave Green
